rules.statement: A renunciation by a Viharadhipathi of his right to be Viharadhipathi may be inferred from facts and circumstances, but such an inference will not be drawn if the matter is left in a state of doubt.
rules.supporting_quote: "Although a renunciation by a Viharadhipathi of his right to be Viharadhipathi may be inferred from facts and circumstances, such an inference will not be drawn if the matter is left in a state of doubt."

meta.parties: Warakapitiya Sangananda Terunnanse v. Meeruppe Sumanatissa Terunnanse
